elsewhere.note: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.
“ ‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to…
and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the mountain, and get olive branches, branches of wild…
Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.
“ ‘I will utterly consume them, says Yahweh. No grapes will be on the vine, no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf will fade. The things that I have given them…
